links.outcome: Readability (FRE, ARI, GFI) of LLM radiology report explanations relative to patient reading level
links.effect: ChatGPT most readable (FRE 60.33 ± 3.65; ARI 9.66 ± 1.01; GFI 9.1 ± 1.04), with ARI and GFI grade levels around 9-10 (above typical recommended patient reading level).
links.quote: ChatGPT produced the most readable (FRE: 60.33 ± 3.65; ARI: 9.66 ± 1.01; GFI: 9.1 ± 1.04) and understandable (PEMAT-U: 89.58 ± 3.90%) responses (p < 0.01).

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the capability and communication features of three off-the-shelf LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot) in explaining radiology reports to patients without evaluating an operational safeguard or deployment practice.
